data_roles.scored_development: 2020-2022 only; expected n=5478; already consumed labels
data_roles.past_results: strictly earlier completed league matches only
data_roles.future_schedule: fixture usable only when exact source snapshot/commit was published before target kickoff and already contained that fixture
data_roles.unknown_future_competition: MISSING, never interpreted as no match

mechanism.past_congestion: completed matches in trailing 3/7/14 days before kickoff
mechanism.rest_before: days since team's last completed match, clipped 2..21
mechanism.standings_importance: from standings reconstructed only from earlier completed league matches; generic title/top-quintile/bottom-quintile point-gap proximity, no league-specific exceptions
mechanism.future_rest_after: days to next PIT-proven scheduled match; candidate future component disabled when unavailable
mechanism.next_importance_gap: PIT-proven next league opponent evaluated using current pre-match standings; missing if next fixture is not proven
mechanism.expected_rotation_pressure: weighted standardized congestion + short rest-before + short rest-after + positive next-vs-current importance gap
mechanism.activation: future-aware candidate activates only when both teams have PIT-proven next fixtures; otherwise exact Frozen V3.1.1 fallback
mechanism.bridge: keep Frozen V3.1.1 draw probability unchanged; shift conditional home-v-away logit by -0.10*clip(home_pressure-away_pressure,-3,3); region-rescale frozen score matrix

forbidden: unknown cup schedule equals no cup
